_note: EDIT ME. Viseme map for Aloy's mouth (Jarvis 111326, from Nimbus's research /workspace/board/notes/visemes-lipsync-111326.md). Chain: sound -> Oculus viseme (15) -> mouth frame 'shape' at 'level' (half or full). Kokoro demos use 'ipa' (timed phonemes from the timestamped Kokoro model); typed text uses 'letters' (rough English spelling rules). Change a shape or move a sound and reload: the page maps at play time, no rebuild. Frames that exist (Cora talking/amused): closed (= amused rest), slight, ah, oh, ee, each with half and full. The page blends between mouth frames (short crossfade) instead of snapping, per the note.
standard: Oculus/Meta 15 visemes (= MPEG-4 14 + sil), collapsed to the 5 existing frames; Rhubarb A-H+X column for reference

PP.art: APPROX: P/B/M want pressed lips; no pressed-lips frame, using the closed smile

FF.art: MISSING: F/V upper teeth on lower lip; using slight (half)

TH.art: MISSING: TH tongue at the teeth; using slight

DD.art: near-neutral per note (T/D hard to see); slight half

kk.art: near-neutral per note (K/G hard to see); slight half

CH.art: APPROX: SH/CH/JH want lips pushed forward; no frame, using ee half

SS.art: ok: S/Z teeth near, lips spread

nn.art: near-neutral; MISSING: held-L tongue-up frame (Rhubarb H)

RR.art: APPROX: R/ER slightly rounded; oh half

E.art: ok-ish: EH/AE open, narrower than aa; ah half

ih.art: ok: IH/IY teeth showing, lips spread

ou.art: APPROX: UW/UH/W want puckered lips; no pucker frame, small round oh half

letters._note: Longest match first. 'hold' = keep the previous mouth; 'next' = take the next sound's mouth (H, per the note); 'skip' = silent.

missing: FF upper teeth on lower lip (Rhubarb G)
